methods.name: Year-over-year normalised search-growth calculation
methods.goal: Quantify momentum behind prospective 2026 trends on Pinterest.
methods.description: Pinterest compared the volume of normalised, English-language searches made worldwide between September 2024 – August 2025 with the same window a year earlier (September 2023 – August 2024). The resulting % change was used to flag fast-rising topics.

methods.name: Early-adopter generational indexing
methods.goal: Reveal which age cohorts are disproportionately fueling each trend.
methods.description: For every trend, Pinterest identified the generations whose search activity grew more than their average platform activity over the same period, labelling them as “Early adopters”.
